mapper.select: SELECT course_no,is_completed,progress,TO_CHAR(e.regdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') as dbday,title,m.name as instructor,thumbnail FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE e.member_id=#{member_id} ORDER BY e.regdate DESC

SELECT course_no,progress,title,m.name as instructor,thumbnail,last_accessed FROM course_enrollment e JOIN course c ON e.course_no=c.no JOIN member m ON c.instructor_no=m.member_id WHERE e.member_id=#{member_id} AND last_accessed >= SYSDATE-7 ORDER BY last_accessed DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
